question: Should provider-branded confetti ship with the persistent per-provider palette editor, or should this PR be narrowed to curated defaults only?
rationale: Both scopes appear implementable and tested, but repository evidence does not establish whether permanent user customization is worth its settings, localization, persistence, and maintenance surface.

options.title: Land branded defaults only
options.body: Keep provider-specific reset colors while removing the override store, editor, preview notification, and associated localization surface.

options.title: Ship defaults and editor
options.body: Accept persistent local palette overrides as a supported provider setting and retain the current editing and preview workflow.

recommendation.title: Land branded defaults only
recommendation.body: Keep provider-specific reset colors while removing the override store, editor, preview notification, and associated localization surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor explicitly requested this product-scope decision from the repository owner, and it concerns the app's permanent settings surface.
